threat_model: A genuine counterparty or person-subject artifact is accidentally copied under examples/artifacts and bundled into a public handoff zip.
A public redaction or protocol relay is treated as raw custody because it is convenient and visible.
A local filesystem path or private contact locator leaks through a public ledger even when bytes are excluded.

hard_fail_conditions: live-candidate ledger points to examples/artifacts or another public release-tree payload
private/raw vault prefix exists inside the archive root
non-synthetic payload under examples/artifacts would be packaged
live-candidate source locator is not redacted to a hash-only public form

allowed_public_artifacts.reason: Synthetic dry-run bytes used to prove hashing/copying behavior; no live counterparty or private subject material.
Immutable copy of the synthetic dry-run control; it cannot open LEAP or affect live floor.

decision.may_stage_real_artifact: yes-only-through-external-private-vault-plus-public-shell; no raw live payload may be placed under examples/artifacts

public_summary: rev0217 carries forward the private evidence vault policy while adding the first-artifact pilot route; raw live-counterparty bytes still cannot enter the release tree.
